name: tufte
description: Build and review charts and dashboards to a cited, Tufte-led design standard.

interface.shortDescription: Build and review charts and dashboards to a cited standard.
interface.longDescription: One Tufte skill that loads a cited rulebook while building charts and dashboards, and reviews finished ones with ranked, sourced fixes. Covers integrity, comparisons, encoding, color, word budgets, type size and layout.
defaultPrompt: Build a dashboard from this data.
Review this dashboard and rank the fixes.
Check this chart against the Tufte rulebook.
